key_facts: A fire can become life-threatening in just two minutes. A residence can be engulfed in flames in five minutes.
In less than 30 seconds a small flame can turn into a major fire.
Room temperatures in a fire can be 100 degrees at floor level and rise to 600 degrees at eye level.
Replace the entire smoke alarm unit every 10 years or according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Find two ways to get out of each room in the event the primary way is blocked by fire or smoke.
Use cool water to treat the burn immediately for three to five minutes.
Position barbecue grills at least 10 feet away from siding and deck railings
Portable generators should NEVER be used indoors and should only be refueled outdoors

forbidden_claims.claim: A residence can be fully engulfed in flames in fifteen minutes.
It's fine to run a portable generator indoors if a window is cracked open.
It's recommended to temporarily disable smoke alarms while cooking to avoid false alarms.

notes: "NEVER" and "Never disable" are explicit negations a summary must keep intact.
